Elena (Design): Quick design QA: noticed three related nits in Console during compact density review: 1) success toasts briefly steal visible focus outline from toolbar buttons when a modal closes, 2) segmented control hit targets shrink below comfy minimum, 3) copy inconsistent across save vs autosave toasts. Video + Figma frame attached. Kai (Frontend): Repro: open settings modal -> save -> modal closes -> toast appears bottom-right. Visual focus ring moves from the previously-focused toolbar button to a faint blur while the toast animates in, then returns. Keyboard users reported confusion. Also compact token `spacing.dense-gap` set to 6px makes segmented control icons feel cramped. Maya (a11y): For toasts: don't move focus on success; keep focus restoration deterministic (return to last focused element). Use `role=status` + `aria-live=polite` for success and `role=alert` for errors. If a toast must be linked to the element (eg. "Saved draft for X"), prefer `aria-describedby` on the focused control rather than focus shift. Example: `
Saved
` and `focusedEl.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 't-1643')`. Omar (Product): Copy: standardize to: success = noun-first short form ("Draft saved"), autosave = "Autosaved" (timestamp optional), error = "Save failed". Also enforce that actionable toasts include explicit CTA text like "Undo delete" rather than generic "Undo". Kai (Frontend): Implementation plan: 1) never call `.focus()` on toast for success flows, 2) give each toast unique id `toast-`, 3) expose optional `attachTo(element)` which sets `aria-describedby`, 4) ensure toasts are `aria-hidden=true` while a modal trap is active unless attached to modal. Code sketch: `const id = 'toast-'+Date.now(); render(`
${msg}
`); if(el) el.setAttribute('aria-describedby', id);` Maya (a11y): One more nit: animated show/hide can steal announcement in some SRs if the node is removed quickly. For swipe dismiss / quick animation, keep an offscreen live copy for 600ms before removal. Also ensure `prefers-reduced-motion` respected. Theo (Mobile): Mobile note: quick gestures that dismiss toasts often prevent TalkBack/TalkBack-like services from reading. We'll keep swipe-to-dismiss for non-actionable toasts and make actionable ones non-swipable by default. If actionable, we also pin for 2500ms or until user dismisses. Elena (Design): Spacing token: set `spacing.dense-gap` back to 8px min for segmented controls and toolbar icons, but keep visual density by reducing internal icon padding instead. That keeps hit targets without blowing up layout. I'll update Figma tokens and post frames in #design-assets. Kai (Frontend): I'll add token `hit.minSize=44` and apply invisible hit padding for icon-only controls, update toast API to include `attachTo`, and make toasts avoid stealing focus. Will open PR tonight. Snippet: `if (options.attachTo) { el.setAttribute('aria-describedby', id) }` Maya (a11y): Also add lint rule: icon-only buttons must have `aria-label`. We'll run a quick a11y check after PR. Omar (Product): And add a tiny regression test: quick open/close modal -> save -> assert focus is on toolbar button after flow (not toast). Also check compact density for segmented control hitbox. ci-bot: New PR: frontend#2899 - "toasts: attachTo aria-describedby + no focus steal; tokens: min-hit + dense-gap tweak" opened by kai. Kai (Frontend): Thanks! Tagging @Maya and @Elena for review. I'll add e2e and unit tests for toast life-cycle and aria-describedby behavior. ETA: tomorrow morning. :rocket:
